parameters.query:
SELECT l.id as lead_id, l.company_id, l.qualification_score, l.identified_opportunity, l.recommended_solution, c.name as company_name, c.website, c.country, c.city, c.industry
FROM public.leads l
JOIN public.companies c ON l.company_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN public.outreach_messages m ON m.lead_id = l.id
WHERE l.qualification_score >= 80
  AND m.id IS NULL
LIMIT 5;

INSERT INTO public.contacts (
  company_id,
  full_name,
  email,
  normalized_email,
  job_title,
  country,
  source_type,
  verification_status,
  marketing_eligibility_status
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  lower(trim($3)),
  $4,
  $5,
  'website',
  'pending',
  'pending'
) ON CONFLICT (normalized_email) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, full_name, email, normalized_email;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.outreach_messages (
  lead_id,
  contact_id,
  sequence_number,
  subject,
  body,
  personalisation_notes,
  quality_score,
  status,
  scheduled_at
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, 0, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'pending_approval', now() + interval '1 hour'
)
ON CONFLICT (contact_id, sequence_number) DO UPDATE SET
  subject = EXCLUDED.subject,
  body = EXCLUDED.body,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, lead_id, contact_id, status;
